question: How do I submit the hard copy of the POD?
alternate_questions: physical pod submission process|hard copy pod kahan bhejna hai|original bilti submit kaise karein
answer: Submit the original signed and stamped physical POD at the nearest Road Express branch office or courier it to our central hub with the trip LR number clearly written on the envelope. For branch address confirmation, reach out to [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: Can I upload a digital copy of the POD for fast clearance?
alternate_questions: soft copy pod upload|photo of pod chalegi kya|digital bilti upload process
answer: Yes, you can upload clear photos of all pages of the stamped and signed consignee POD through our partner portal or mobile app to trigger provisional clearance. Ensure the consignee seal, signature, and receiving date are clearly visible or contact [OPERATIONS CONTACT] for upload assistance.

question: What is the verification status of my uploaded POD?
alternate_questions: pod verification status kya hai|meri gadi ka pod approve hua ya nahi|check pod status for truck
answer: Verification status is tied to specific vehicle and LR records. Please share your trip LR number and vehicle registration number with [OPERATIONS CONTACT] so they can inspect the verification log and confirm whether the consignee signature was approved or flagged.

question: When and how is the trip advance payment processed?
alternate_questions: advance payment kab milega|gadi load hone ke baad advance kitna time lagta hai|trip advance payment rules
answer: Trip advance is transferred via IMPS or NEFT directly to the registered fleet owner bank account within 3 to 4 hours after loading completion and digital receipt of the signed loading slip. For processing delays, contact [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: What percentage of total freight is provided as advance?
alternate_questions: advance kitna percent milta hai|standard advance percentage kya hai|advance diesel slip and cash ratio
answer: Road Express provides up to 70% to 80% of the agreed freight value as advance, split between cash bank transfer and diesel cards depending on lane agreement. The remaining balance is held until verified POD submission, as verified by [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: Why has the advance for my loaded truck not been credited?
alternate_questions: mera advance abhi tak kyu nahi aaya|truck loaded advance pending|advance payment issue for vehicle
answer: Advance release requires validation against your active trip contract and loading slip timestamp. Please provide your truck number and loading slip copy to [FINANCE CONTACT] to check bank dispatch logs and resolve bank validation holds.

question: What is the standard payment cycle for balance settlement?
alternate_questions: balance payment kitne din me aata hai|pod ke baad balance settlement time|final freight payment cycle
answer: Balance payments are scheduled for release within 7 to 10 working days following the approval of the physical POD and verification of shortage or damage deductions. Any query regarding batch payout dates should be directed to [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: What documents are required for clearing the balance freight payment?
alternate_questions: balance lene ke liye kya documents chahiye|final payment documents list|clearance ke liye bilti aur bills
answer: Final balance settlement requires the original stamped POD, the original toll or weighbridge receipts if agreed in contract, and an invoice copy for GST-registered suppliers. Submit your document bundle to [FINANCE CONTACT] for settlement.

question: When will the balance payment for my completed trip be released?
alternate_questions: mera balance payment kab clear hoga|check balance status for trip|kitna balance bacha hai meri gadi ka
answer: Balance payment release dates depend on your specific trip account ledger and POD verification date. Please furnish your Trip ID and vehicle number to [FINANCE CONTACT] to check your pending settlement docket and payment batch date.

question: How are vehicle detention and haltage charges calculated?
alternate_questions: detention charges kaise calculate hote hai|haltage per day rate kya hai|truck khadi hone ka paisa kaise milta hai
answer: Detention charges start after a 24-hour grace period from vehicle reporting time at loading or unloading points. Standard haltage ranges between Rs 1000 and Rs 2500 per day depending on truck type, provided reporting was logged with [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: How do I report and claim vehicle detention at the destination?
alternate_questions: unloading point par detention kaise lagayein|reporting entry kaise karein|gadi khadi hone par haltage claim process
answer: Have the consignee security or warehouse supervisor stamp the vehicle arrival time on your copy of the LR upon arrival. Immediately send a photo of the timestamped LR along with vehicle GPS location to [OPERATIONS CONTACT] to register an official detention claim.

question: Has the detention claim for my waiting truck been approved?
alternate_questions: kya meri gadi ka haltage approve hua|check detention status for my truck|detention approval status
answer: Detention approval requires cross-verification of GPS geo-fencing data and warehouse logsheets for that specific truck trip. Share your vehicle registration number and active trip LR with [OPERATIONS CONTACT] to inspect the claim status.

question: What should I do if the consignor takes more than 24 hours to load?
alternate_questions: loading me 24 ghante se zyada delay ho raha hai|factory me loading nahi ho rahi kya karein|loading delay escalation
answer: If loading is delayed beyond 24 hours from scheduled reporting, request a delay slip or stamped entry record from the warehouse incharge and immediately escalate to [OPERATIONS CONTACT] so detention billing can be triggered or alternate loading instructions issued.

question: What are the vehicle placement and loading inspection guidelines?
alternate_questions: loading ke time truck condition kya honi chahiye|gadi placement rules kya hai|tarpaulin and body check guidelines
answer: Vehicles placed for loading must have clean and dry cargo beds, intact waterproof tarpaulins, functional lashing ropes, and valid vehicle fitness certificates. Drivers must oversee weight distribution during loading and report any carton damage immediately to [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: Who is responsible for paying unloading labor and hamali charges?
alternate_questions: unloading hamali kaun dega|unloading charges kiski responsibility hai|kanta parchi aur hamali payment
answer: Unless explicitly stipulated as a supplier charge on your advance agreement, unloading labor and hamali are payable directly by the consignee at the destination warehouse. If consignee forces payment, collect an official cash receipt and submit to [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: What should the driver do if the consignee refuses to unload the cargo?
alternate_questions: consignee maal utaarne se mana kar raha hai|destination par rejection ho gaya kya karein|customer unloading refusal
answer: The driver must never unload goods at an unauthorized site or leave the premises without written instructions. Secure the truck, take photos of the sealed cargo, and immediately call [OPERATIONS CONTACT] to liaise with the consignee commercial manager.

question: Under what conditions are shortage or damage penalties deducted?
alternate_questions: penalty kab kat ti hai|shortage aur damage deduction rules|material damage hone par fine kitna lagega
answer: Penalties are deducted from freight settlement only if consignee stamps a formal shortage or damage endorsement on the original POD with itemized seal numbers and box counts. All deductions follow customer debit notes verified by [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: How can a fleet owner dispute an unfair damage penalty?
alternate_questions: penalty dispute kaise karein|galat deduction ki complaint kahan karein|unfair penalty appeal process
answer: You can dispute any deduction by submitting loading-point dispatch photos, weighbridge slips showing gross weight consistency, and intact seal logs within 7 days of settlement notice to [FINANCE CONTACT] and [OPERATIONS CONTACT] for joint review.

question: Why was a penalty deducted from my recent trip settlement?
alternate_questions: mere payment me se penalty kyu kati|deduction details for my trip|check penalty reason for vehicle
answer: Penalty deductions are tied to specific trip shortage claims, transit delay SLA breaches, or customer debit memos. Provide your trip LR number and vehicle registration to [FINANCE CONTACT] to view the itemized deduction breakdown and POD endorsement.

question: What KYC documents are required for onboarding a new vehicle or fleet?
alternate_questions: new vendor onboarding documents|truck attach karne ke liye kya kagaz chahiye|kyc documents list for fleet owner
answer: To register as an approved supplier, submit clear scans of your PAN card, Aadhaar card, cancelled bank cheque, GST certificate if registered, vehicle RC, valid National Permit, insurance policy, and fitness certificate to [SUPPLY CONTACT].

question: How do I update expired vehicle insurance or fitness certificates?
alternate_questions: insurance renew hone ke baad upload kaise karein|fitness certificate update process|expired vehicle documents update
answer: You can upload renewed RC, insurance policy, or fitness certificates through our partner vendor app or email high-resolution PDF copies mentioning your vehicle number to [SUPPLY CONTACT] to prevent vehicle de-allocation on active routes.

question: How do I update my bank account details for freight transfers?
alternate_questions: bank account change kaise karein|bank details update process|new bank cheque upload for payments
answer: Bank account modifications require a formal written letter on supplier letterhead along with a fresh cancelled cheque bearing your printed name or firm name. Submit these documents in person or via verified email to [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: What primary freight routes and lanes does Road Express operate on?
alternate_questions: road express ke routes kaunse hai|kis lane par gadi chalti hai|major operational corridors of road express
answer: Road Express specializes in primary and secondary full-truckload (FTL) corridors across North, West, and South India, including Delhi-NCR, Mumbai-Pune, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, and Hyderabad. For lane enquiries, contact [SALES CONTACT].

question: What are Road Express support operating hours and emergency contacts?
alternate_questions: office timings kya hai|customer care helpline number|road express support contact hours
answer: Road Express operational control centers operate 24/7 for active highway tracking, driver emergency assistance, and breakdown management. Head office administrative and billing desks are active Monday to Saturday from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM at [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: How can a fleet owner become a contracted regular supplier for Road Express?
alternate_questions: regular vendor kaise bane|fleet contract sign karne ka tarika|attach fleet with road express
answer: Fleet operators owning 3 or more commercial vehicles can apply for regular monthly lane contracts by submitting their fleet profile and operating corridors to our vendor acquisition desk at [SUPPLY CONTACT].

question: What is Munshiana and is it deducted from our freight payment?
alternate_questions: munshiana kya hota hai|kya freight me se munshiana kat te hai|munshiana deduction policy
answer: Munshiana refers to traditional loading station clerical handling charges. Road Express maintains a transparent digital billing system where unauthorized branch commission or informal munshiana deductions are strictly prohibited; any dispute can be reported to [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: Is a formal TDS or deduction certificate provided for any retained administrative fees?
alternate_questions: deduction certificate milega kya|form 16a or tds receipt for munshiana|tax deduction receipt for freight
answer: Road Express provides quarterly Form 16A TDS certificates and transparent freight summary settlement vouchers reflecting all statutory deductions in compliance with Income Tax regulations. Request your certificates from [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: How do I download and register on the RoadExpress Partner App?
alternate_questions: partner app download kaise karein|roadexpress partner app install|carrier app registration process
answer: Download the RoadExpress Partner App from the Google Play Store. Open the app, select Transporter/Carrier role, and complete registration using your mobile number, PAN, and vehicle details. After verification you can start browsing loads and managing your fleet. For any registration issues contact [SUPPLY CONTACT] or email connect@roadexpressfreight.com.

question: How can I add or manage multiple trucks in the Partner App?
alternate_questions: fleet me naye truck add kaise karein|multiple vehicle registration|truck list update in app
answer: Log in to the RoadExpress Partner App, go to Fleet Management Hub, and use the Add Vehicle option. Upload clear scans of RC, insurance, fitness certificate, and National Permit. Once approved, the truck appears in your live fleet list and becomes eligible for load matching. For bulk uploads or status queries contact [SUPPLY CONTACT].

question: How does the smart bidding system work for loads?
alternate_questions: load bid kaise lagaye|dynamic bidding process|fare negotiation in partner app
answer: Open the live load marketplace in the Partner App, view detailed cargo specs, pickup/delivery locations, and timelines. Submit your competitive bid. You can track your bid rank in real time. If accepted, the trip is assigned to your selected vehicle. For bidding-related guidance contact [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: Can I see load details before placing a bid?
alternate_questions: bid se pehle load details dikhte hain kya|cargo specification check|load information before bidding
answer: Yes. Every load card shows full details including origin, destination, cargo type/weight, vehicle requirement, preferred timeline, and any special instructions. Review these carefully before submitting a bid to ensure your truck is suitable.

question: How do I track my active trips in real time?
alternate_questions: trip tracking kaise karein|gadi location live dekhna|real-time vehicle tracking
answer: Use the Trip Status Dashboard inside the Partner App. You will see live GPS location, assigned driver, document status, POD upload status, and payment progress for every active trip. Instant notifications are also sent for any pending actions.

question: What should I do if GPS tracking is not updating?
alternate_questions: gps not working|location update nahi ho raha|tracking issue in app
answer: First ensure the driver’s mobile data and location services are on. Ask the driver to force-close and reopen the app. If the issue persists, share the Trip ID and vehicle number with [OPERATIONS CONTACT] so they can check the tracking feed.

question: How and when are payments credited to my account?
alternate_questions: payment kab aata hai|freight payment process|bank transfer timeline
answer: Advance is normally released via IMPS/NEFT within a few hours of confirmed loading. Balance is released after POD verification as per the agreed cycle. All payments go to the registered bank account linked in your profile. For any payment delay provide Trip ID to [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: Can I get instant payment status updates?
alternate_questions: payment status check kaise karein|advance balance dikhega kya|live payment tracking
answer: Yes. The Partner App shows real-time payment status (Pending / Processing / Credited) for every trip under the Trip Status Dashboard. You also receive push notifications when advance or balance is released.

question: What documents are needed to become a RoadExpress carrier partner?
alternate_questions: carrier onboarding documents|fleet partner banne ke liye kya chahiye|new transporter registration list
answer: You need PAN card, Aadhaar, cancelled cheque, GST certificate (if applicable), vehicle RC, valid National Permit, insurance policy, and fitness certificate. Upload clear scans via the Partner App or email them to [SUPPLY CONTACT].

question: How long does partner verification take?
alternate_questions: verification kitne din me hota hai|account approve hone me time|onboarding approval timeline
answer: Standard verification is completed within 24–48 working hours after all documents are correctly uploaded. You will receive an in-app notification and SMS once your account and vehicles are activated.

question: What are the official support contact details for carriers?
alternate_questions: customer care number|helpline for transporters|road express support contact
answer: For 24/7 operational support call +91-84477-38498. You can also email connect@roadexpressfreight.com. Always keep your Trip ID or vehicle number ready for faster resolution. Head Office and Corporate Office addresses are listed on the website.

question: Is support available 24/7 for drivers on the road?
alternate_questions: 24 hour helpline hai kya|emergency support for drivers|night time assistance
answer: Yes. RoadExpress operational control centres run 24/7 for active trip tracking, driver emergency assistance, and breakdown support. Administrative desks operate Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–6:30 PM.

question: Which major corridors does RoadExpress operate on?
alternate_questions: road express ke main routes|kis lane me gadi chalti hai|pan india coverage
answer: RoadExpress operates across major FTL corridors in North, West, and South India including Delhi-NCR, Mumbai-Pune, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and many intra-state routes. For specific lane availability check the live marketplace or contact [SALES CONTACT].

question: Does the app provide AI-based route optimization?
alternate_questions: route optimization feature|best route suggestion|fuel saving routes
answer: Yes. The Partner App includes AI-powered route optimization that considers real-time traffic, weather, and road conditions to suggest the most efficient path, helping reduce fuel cost and transit time.

question: How do I upload e-POD through the Partner App?
alternate_questions: e-pod upload kaise karein|digital pod submission in app|photo of bilti upload
answer: Open the specific trip in the Partner App, go to Documents section, and upload clear photos of all pages of the stamped and signed consignee POD. Ensure seal, signature, and date are clearly visible. This triggers provisional clearance.

question: What happens if e-POD upload fails?
alternate_questions: e-pod upload nahi ho raha|app me document fail|pod upload error
answer: Check internet connectivity and retry. If it still fails, take screenshots of the error and share them along with Trip ID to connect@roadexpressfreight.com or [OPERATIONS CONTACT] for manual assistance.

question: How does the system match loads to my available trucks?
alternate_questions: load matching kaise hota hai|nearby load suggestion|automatic truck assignment
answer: The platform uses real-time location and vehicle status to automatically suggest suitable loads for your available trucks, reducing empty miles and improving utilization. You can also manually browse and bid.

question: Can I communicate with the assigned driver through the app?
alternate_questions: driver se baat kaise karein|in-app driver chat|trip communication channel
answer: Yes. The Complete Trip Management section provides direct communication channels with the assigned driver for each active trip, along with location and status updates.

question: Where are the RoadExpress offices located?
alternate_questions: head office address|corporate office location|patna gurugram office
answer: Head Office: Rajendra Villa, Savitri Gali, opp-NRL Petrol Pump, Pratap Nagar, Ramkrishna Nagar, Patna, Bihar 800027. Corporate Office: 1st Floor, Front Building, RoadExpress Tower, Exit 12 NH8, near Hero Honda Chowk, Gurugram, Haryana 122004.

question: How many trucks and states does RoadExpress network cover?
alternate_questions: kitne trucks network me|pan india presence|scale of operations
answer: RoadExpress works with a large verified network of trucks operating across multiple states in India, focusing on consistent loads and reliable partnerships for fleet owners. For partnership scale details contact [SUPPLY CONTACT].

question: What is Road Express and what services does the company provide?
alternate_questions: tell me about company|tell me about road express|about road express company|road express company profile|company ke baare me batao|road express kya hai
answer: Road Express is a tech-enabled freight logistics and full-truckload (FTL) transportation service provider connecting fleet owners and enterprise shippers across major pan-India industrial corridors. For corporate inquiries, reach out to [SALES CONTACT] or visit our regional hubs.

question: What is the overall payment structure for advance and balance at Road Express?
alternate_questions: advance balance system|advance aur balance payment process overall|total freight payment structure|advance balance rule
answer: Road Express operates on a structured advance and balance model: up to 70-80% of agreed freight is disbursed as advance upon confirmed loading, while the remaining 20-30% balance is released within 7-10 working days after physical POD verification and audit. For payment account queries, contact [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: What are the standard terms and conditions for carriage and freight contracts?
alternate_questions: Terms and conditions|terms and conditions|terms and conditions kya hai|contract rules and terms|road express terms and conditions
answer: Standard terms and conditions require timely vehicle placement, maintaining valid transit permits and insurance, securing signed and stamped PODs without unauthorized endorsements, adhering to stipulated transit timelines, and accepting verified deductions for transit damages or shortages. Full agreement details are available on our partner portal or via [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: What is the advance percentage and exact timeline or date when advance is credited?
alternate_questions: advance percent and date|advance kitna percent aur kab aayega|advance payment timeline and percentage|advance release date and percentage
answer: Road Express releases between 70% and 80% of agreed freight as trip advance within 3 to 4 hours of loading completion and loading slip verification. Diesel card allocation or bank IMPS transfer dates are communicated immediately upon load dispatch by [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: What percentage of freight is kept as balance and when is the balance payment date?
alternate_questions: balance percent and date|balance kitna percent hota hai aur kab release hoga|remaining freight balance payment date|balance release timeline
answer: The balance amount comprises the remaining 20% to 30% of agreed freight and is scheduled for release within 7 to 10 working days once the original physical POD is verified and approved without damage remarks. You can track payout batch dates by contacting [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: What deductions can be made from a transporter freight settlement?
alternate_questions: Deductions|deductions|deductions kya kya hoti hai|total deductions list|freight settlement deductions
answer: Allowable deductions from freight settlement include statutory TDS (1% for individual/HUF, 2% for firms with PAN), verified shortage or transit cargo damages endorsed on the POD, diesel advances or cash advance already disbursed, and pre-agreed unloading hamali. All deductions are itemized in your payment voucher provided by [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: How are late delivery penalties or transit delay fines calculated?
alternate_questions: late penalties kya hai|late delivery fine rules|transit delay penalty|gadi late pahunchne par penalty kitna lagega
answer: Late delivery penalties apply only when a truck exceeds the contract turnaround time (TAT) without force majeure or logged mechanical breakdowns. Deductions are capped according to lane SLA agreements and require customer delay endorsement. To report genuine highway delays and waive penalty, immediately alert [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: What is the complete timeline and overall lifecycle for POD submission?
alternate_questions: pod story how many days and overall|pod kitne din me submit karna hota hai|pod submission timeline overall|pod cycle how many days
answer: Carriers must submit digital e-POD via the Partner App within 24 hours of unloading and dispatch the physical stamped original POD within 7 to 10 days to the nearest Road Express hub. Physical verification takes 2 to 3 working days from arrival, after which balance clearance is initiated by [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: What is the overall company policy regarding munshiana charges?
alternate_questions: munshiana Overall|munshiana overall|munshiana charges|munshiana policy details|munshiana deduction overall
answer: Road Express has a strict zero-tolerance policy for informal munshiana or unauthorized brokerage deductions from supplier freight payments. All freight agreements reflect net payable amounts transparently. If any branch or loading agent demands unauthorized munshiana, report immediately to [FINANCE CONTACT].

question: Why have I not received payment despite my physical POD reaching the office?
alternate_questions: pod reaching date and why we have not received the payament|pod pahunchne ke baad bhi payment kyu nahi aaya|pod delivered but payment pending|pod received payment not credited
answer: If your physical POD has reached the office but balance payment is pending, common reasons include unverified consignee stamp/signature, pending customer shortage debit memos, or bank batch schedule dates. Please share your LR number and POD courier tracking receipt with [FINANCE CONTACT] to check audit clearance status.

question: What is the complete step-by-step procedure for uploading all required vehicle and trip documents?
alternate_questions: procedures of document upload and all|document upload kaise karein poora process|all document upload procedure|documents submission process overview
answer: To upload documents, open the RoadExpress Partner App, navigate to the relevant section (Profile for PAN/Bank/Aadhaar, Fleet Hub for RC/Fitness/Insurance, or Trip Management for loading slips and e-PODs), attach clear high-resolution photos or PDFs under 5MB, and submit for verification. For manual onboarding assistance, contact [SUPPLY CONTACT].

question: Meri gadi destination par khali nahi ho rahi hai, detention charges kaise lagayein?
alternate_questions: meri gadi khali nhi ho rahi hai|unloading delay detention charges|consignee gadi khali nahi kar raha haltage|detention when truck not unloading
answer: Agar destination warehouse par gadi 24 ghante ke andar khali nahi hoti hai, to turant consignee security ya supervisor se apni LR copy par reporting aur current time ka stamp lagwayein. Is timestamped LR ki photo aur live GPS location [OPERATIONS CONTACT] ko bhejein taaki per-day detention charges Rs 1000 se 2500 official log me activate ho sakein.

question: What is the standard unloading protocol and consignee delivery procedure?
alternate_questions: unloading process|unloading rules and guidelines|delivery at consignee warehouse|unloading protocol
answer: Upon arrival at the consignee facility, the driver must register entry at the gate, obtain an entry token, oversee cargo unloading, cross-check carton counts against the LR, and secure the consignee receiving rubber stamp, signature, and date on the original POD. Report any consignee dispute immediately to [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: Factory ya warehouse par loading nahi ho rahi hai to kya karein?
alternate_questions: loading nhi ho rahi|factory me loading delay ho rahi hai|gadi load nahi kar rahe|placement done but loading pending
answer: Agar vehicle placement ke baad consignor 4 ghante se zyada loading start nahi karta, to turant dispatch supervisor se baat karein aur [OPERATIONS CONTACT] ko report karein. Agar delay 24 ghante cross karta hai to detention charges apply honge ya consignment alternate load par reroute ki jayegi.

question: What should I do if the consignee unloads the truck but does not provide the signed POD?
alternate_questions: unloading point no pod|consignee bilti stamp nahi de raha|unloading done but pod not given|consignee refusing pod stamp
answer: If the consignee unloads goods but withholds the physical POD or rubber stamp, do not move the vehicle from premises. Immediately take photos of unloaded goods on the bay and gate entry pass, and call [OPERATIONS CONTACT] so our commercial team can contact consignee management to release the endorsed POD.

question: What should I do if detention occurred but detention rate or days are not written on the POD?
alternate_questions: pod no detention rate not written|bilti par haltage rate nahi likha|pod without detention endorsement|detention rate missing on pod
answer: If consignee refused to write detention days on the physical POD, Road Express verifies haltage using GPS geofence arrival and departure logs alongside warehouse in/out entry gate slips. Send your GPS trip logs and gate entry photos to [OPERATIONS CONTACT] within 48 hours for detention approval.

question: What happens if unloading or hamali charges are endorsed or deducted on the POD?
alternate_questions: pod pe unloading charges|pod par hamali charges likhe hai|unloading deduction on bilti|hamali charges marked on pod
answer: If the consignee marks unloading or hamali charges on the POD, submit the original official cash receipt collected from the consignee along with the POD. Road Express will verify whether unloading was the shipper contractual obligation and reimburse or waive the charge via [OPERATIONS CONTACT].

question: What is the policy if the loaded cargo exceeds the vehicle passing gross weight (overweight)?
alternate_questions: overweight cargo rules|gadi overweight load ho gayi|overloading policy and fines|kanta parchi overweight issue|overweight
answer: Road Express strictly follows RTO legal gross vehicle weight (GVW) limits. If factory loading causes overweight on the weighbridge slip, the driver must refuse dispatch until excess weight is offloaded. If forced to move, report immediately to [OPERATIONS CONTACT]; Road Express does not reimburse unauthorized RTO overloading penalties.

question: How do I connect directly with the concerned person in charge for my issue?
alternate_questions: alignment to the concerned person|the person in charge|concerned person escalation matrix|kaunse officer se baat karein|alignment
answer: For trip-level operational issues, contact the assigned Route Manager at [OPERATIONS CONTACT]. For payments and TDS deductions, connect with the Accounts Desk at [FINANCE CONTACT]. For vendor contracts and vehicle onboarding, speak with [SUPPLY CONTACT]. For corporate contracts and freight booking, contact [SALES CONTACT].

question: What departments exist at Road Express and what does each department handle?
alternate_questions: type of department|departments in road express|finance sales supply operations roles|department responsibilities overview|types of department
answer: Road Express has four specialized departments: 1) OPERATIONS manages live truck tracking, loading, unloading, detention, and POD processing. 2) FINANCE handles trip advances, balance settlement, diesel cards, and TDS deductions. 3) SUPPLY manages fleet onboarding, KYC verification, and carrier contracts. 4) SALES handles customer enterprise freight contracts and lane pricing.

question: What is the complete carrier onboarding process with Road Express?
alternate_questions: onboarding process|how to onboard as a carrier|carrier onboarding process steps|transporter onboarding process|onboarding kaise karein|onboarding process kya hai
answer: The carrier onboarding process involves 3 simple steps: 1) Download the RoadExpress Partner App or contact [SUPPLY CONTACT]. 2) Upload KYC documents (PAN, Aadhaar, cancelled cheque) and vehicle documents (RC, Insurance, Fitness, National Permit). 3) Account verification and digital contract activation within 24 to 48 hours. Once verified, you can start browsing loads and receive instant trip advances.
